name: Thrips (Haplothrips)
description: Thrips (Haplothrips sp.) - expected flower-feeders, but their high nitrogen isotopes made the source class them as possible predators; the mixing model estimates them as the main prey of the parasitoid wasps (75%) and significant prey of the jumping spider. Their own food within this web is not resolved. Species node matching the source's Haplothrips sp. taxon.
